grades.label: Prime
grades.description: Exceptional. Faithful to the prompt, technically clean, aesthetically strong. Would ship as-is.

grades.label: Choice
grades.description: Strong result with minor blemishes a careful eye can find.

grades.label: Select
grades.description: Competent and recognizable; noticeable flaws on one or more axes.

grades.label: Standard
grades.description: Gets the idea across despite significant defects.

grades.label: Utility
grades.description: The lowest tier. Barely fit for purpose; kept for the record (and the comedy).

axes.label: Prompt fidelity
axes.description: Did the model draw what was asked? Omissions, additions, misreadings. (Defunct as of v6, 2026-07-29 — superseded by Instruction following; kept for responses graded under it.)

values.label: Faithful
values.description: All requested elements present as specified.

values.label: Partial
values.description: Some requested elements missing, extra, or misread.

values.label: Off-brief
values.description: Substantially not the thing that was asked for.

axes.label: Geometry & topology
axes.description: Path construction: self-intersections, broken joins, misaligned shapes, impossible anatomy. (Defunct as of v6, 2026-07-29 — superseded by Integrity; kept for responses graded under it.)

values.label: Clean
values.description: No visible construction errors.

values.label: Minor defects
values.description: Small misalignments or overlaps visible on inspection.

values.label: Major defects
values.description: Structural errors that dominate the read of the image.

axes.label: Color & rendering
axes.description: Palette coherence, gradient quality, fill/stroke errors, z-order mistakes. (Defunct as of v6, 2026-07-29 — kept for responses graded under it.)

values.label: Clean
values.description: Palette and rendering read as intended.

values.label: Minor defects
values.description: Off colors, banding, or stacking slips that don't break the image.

values.label: Major defects
values.description: Rendering errors that break the image.

axes.label: Composition
axes.description: Framing, balance, use of the canvas; is the subject well-placed and scaled? (Defunct as of v6, 2026-07-29 — kept for responses graded under it.)

values.label: Clean
values.description: Well-composed within its viewBox.

values.label: Minor defects
values.description: Awkward margins, crowding, or scale oddities.

values.label: Major defects
values.description: Subject clipped, marooned, or scaled absurdly.

axes.label: Instruction following
axes.description: Did the output honor each explicit ask — elements, constraints, viewpoint, style requests?

values.label: Followed
values.description: Every explicit ask is honored as specified.

values.label: Drifted
values.description: Some asks bent, missed, or quietly replaced.

values.label: Ignored
values.description: Explicit asks are disregarded outright.

axes.label: Restraint
axes.description: Did the model stick to what was asked — or add unrequested elements, decoration, and flourishes?

values.label: Disciplined
values.description: Nothing appears that the prompt didn't call for.

values.label: Embellished
values.description: Unrequested extras crept in without taking over.

values.label: Overgrown
values.description: Additions crowd or upstage what was actually asked for.

axes.label: Integrity
axes.description: Does the picture hold together — parts connect, joins meet, anatomy is possible, occlusion and viewpoint stay consistent?

values.label: Sound
values.description: Coherent construction; nothing floats, breaks, or contradicts itself.

values.label: Strained
values.description: Visible seams — small breaks, misalignments, or spatial slips.

values.label: Broken
values.description: Structural or spatial failures dominate the read.

axes.label: Style
axes.description: Is the image one consistent visual language, well executed — whatever language it chose?

values.label: Unified
values.description: One coherent visual language throughout.

values.label: Mixed
values.description: Registers collide — parts of the image speak different styles.

values.label: Incoherent
values.description: No governing style survives the image.

axes.label: Je ne sais quoi
axes.description: The intangible — whatever makes a piece more than the sum of its axes. Not captured elsewhere; graded anyway.

values.label: Abundant
values.description: The piece has it — undeniable, unaccountable appeal.

values.label: Trace
values.description: A glimmer of something beyond competence.

values.label: None detected
values.description: Technically present, spiritually absent.

sizeTiers.label: Extra small
sizeTiers.description: Tiny — a fleck or trinket, easily lost among the larger junk.

sizeTiers.label: Small
sizeTiers.description: A minor curio; reads small but distinct.

sizeTiers.label: Medium
sizeTiers.description: The default; a middling object in the drawer.

sizeTiers.label: Large
sizeTiers.description: Prominent; claims real space in the well.

changelog.note: Initial taxonomy: 5-tier grade scale, 4 axes, starter model registry.
Relabel utility: "Utility Grade" -> "Utility" (the display context already says Grade:).
Add sizeTiers: 5-tier curatorial size scale (xs/s/m/l/xl) as data. Per-item sizeScale remains the continuous fine dial on top of the tier.

Axes reworked: prompt-fidelity, geometry, color, composition marked defunct (kept — filed responses reference them; never surveyed again). Five new axes: instruction-following, restraint, integrity, style, je-ne-sais-quoi.
